title: Opinions 2
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Node status checked first and it is `coming`, so this one is inside P-b2c1-stub — see the DECISIONS entry about the eleven grammar units that were not. b1_opinions (36) owns the everyday stance chunks: I'd say, in my view, it seems to me, personally, the way I see it, on balance, I reckon, if you ask me, to be honest, from my point of view, I'm convinced, on the other hand, what's more, then again, whereas, it depends, that said, overall, having said that, I suppose, to some extent, I tend to think, as far as I know. None of that is repeated. The B2 layer is register and precision rather than more ways to say *I think*: claiming something in a way that survives disagreement (I would argue that, it could be argued, there is no doubt, it stands to reason, arguably, presumably), HEDGING THE SCOPE of a claim, which is the thing B1 cannot do at all (broadly speaking, strictly speaking, by and large, up to a point, in principle against in practice, more often than not, on the face of it), and conceding ground without giving it up (I take your point, that is a fair point, I beg to differ, admittedly, in fairness, mind you, far from it, quite the opposite). That middle board is the reason the unit exists: a B2 speaker states everything at full strength and then has to retreat, because nobody has given them *up to a point* or *in principle*. NOTE for the record: the formal CONNECTORS — moreover, furthermore, nevertheless, consequently, hence, in contrast — belong in b2_discourse_markers, which is a `parked` node this lane may not draft. They are deliberately NOT smuggled in here; they are connectors, not stance chunks, and F2 says a topic with no unit of its own does not get smuggled into a neighbour. C57 card 0 recaps Opinions 1.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Opinions 1 gave you plenty of ways to say what you think — I'd say, in my view, it seems to me, personally, on balance, if you ask me, to be honest, I'm convinced, it depends, that said, overall, I suppose. This unit does not add more of those. What is new is how strongly you claim it, how much of it you claim, and how you give ground without losing the argument.
cards.note_cz: Opinions 1 ti dal spoustu způsobů, jak říct, co si myslíš — I'd say, in my view, it seems to me, personally, on balance, if you ask me, to be honest, I'm convinced, it depends, that said, overall, I suppose. Tahle lekce další nepřidává. Nové je, jak silně to tvrdíš, jak velkou část toho tvrdíš a jak ustoupíš, aniž bys prohrál.

cards.title: Claim less, win more
points: A B1 speaker states everything at full strength and then has to retreat.
These phrases put the limit **in** the claim, so there is nothing to retreat from.

rows: I agree with you **up to a point**.
